card.name: Just before a hyphen joining compound terms
card.fires_on: The word or digit right before a hyphen that starts a compound, such as 'include' before '-book', a digit before '-fold' or '-day', or 'of' in 'origin-of-the-universe'. It also fires on a space before a dash bullet.

modes.label: Number before -fold or -day
modes.description: A digit inside a number where a hyphenated unit like -fold or -day comes next.

modes.label: Word before hyphenated compound
modes.description: A word or small linking word followed by a hyphen that joins it to the next word.
modes.example: scientists can test the validity of various origin<<-of>>-the-universe models

modes.label: Space before dash list item
modes.description: A space or closing mark just before a dash that opens the next list item.
modes.example: Some common symptoms include: -The need to go all the time<< >>-Burning sensation while urinating

card.writes: It promotes capitalized hyphen-joined pieces like '-W', '-H' and '-door', so it prepares a hyphenated continuation.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a hyphen is about to follow and join the next word or number part.
